version: Hunyuan3D 2.1 (official Hugging Face Space, logged out)
free_tier: 2 GPU min a day logged out (shapes only)
licence_note: Tencent Hunyuan 3D 2.1 Community License: excludes the EU, UK and South Korea; outputs may not train other models.
plan: Free, logged out (2 GPU min a day)
test: Three desk-lamp photos to untextured meshes, one run each, Space defaults (30 steps, guidance 5, octree 256, background removal on, random seed); then one textured attempt.

runs.observed: Shattered: the head and a short arm survive, the rest is six disconnected wire-thin pieces.
Arm, spring arm and shade intact; the tabletop was kept as a flat slab under the lamp.
Clean: one piece, both arm sections and joints, shade and base.

textured_attempt.error: The requested GPU duration (270s) is larger than the maximum allowed. Subscribe to Hugging Face PRO to allow GPU tasks up to 40 min

seconds_to_result_note: Wall clock from submit to result minus queue time, measured by scripts/auto_capture_hf.py; mean of 20.8, 18.0 and 22.3 s. GPU seconds are the Space's own timer (remove background + shape generation), 18.6 + 17.8 + 18.2 = 54.6, shown rounded per run (19, 18, 18).
verdict_reason: Two of three lamps came back as usable, one-piece shapes in about 20 seconds each, free and without a login; the chrome lamp shattered, and textures need more GPU time than a logged-out visitor gets.

sources.label: Tencent: 20 free generations a day on the hosted app
